blogPosts.title: Bridal Prep: Skincare Secrets for a Flawless Foundation
blogPosts.content: Every bride wants their makeup to look flawless and last all day. The secret isn't just in the foundation—it's in the skin preparation. Learn how to optimize your skin barrier in the 4 weeks leading up to your wedding to ensure Pat McGrath or NARS pigments sit beautifully and absorb seamlessly under high-flash studio cameras.

blogPosts.title: Designing the Perfect Screen Look: HD Camera Matching
blogPosts.content: Makeup for film and television requires a completely different approach than bridal or everyday glam. With 8K digital cameras capturing every pore, the technique must focus on high-definition matte layering, color-correction gradients, and sweat-proofing. Here, we outline the exact on-set touch-up routines we use for lead actors to guarantee screen continuity.
